summary.text: Lou DiPalma is a Democratic state senator who has represented Rhode Island State Senate District 12 since January 6, 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia, which lists him as Louis DiPalma, gives his profession as engineering director.

paragraphs.text: DiPalma earned a B.S. in computer engineering from the University of Bridgeport in 1983 and an M.S. in computer science from Brown University in 1989.
He has worked for Raytheon since 1983, in roles from engineer to, since 2010, engineering director.
He served on the Middletown Town Council from 2004 to 2008.
